samples.name: prop-survey-peg
samples.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Reference images are style guides only. One 16x16 logical pixel sprite enlarged to 1024x1024 with each logical pixel a solid 64x64 square, strict aligned 16 by 16 grid. Subject: one short pointed wooden stake driven into the ground, with a strip of red cloth tied on top and a small ground shadow. Cozy medieval Slavic village game. Match reference simplicity: flat warm earth colors, 2-3 shades per material, light top left. South-facing top-down view, not isometric. Transparent background, one pixel margin, single object. No gradients, antialiasing, neon edge colors, glow, haze, tiny details, text, logos or scenery.
